sentences.text: The skeleton is defined by extremely tall neural spines along the back, especially above the hips, and club-shaped tips on the first few tail vertebrae that may signal old age.
Earlier estimates placed the animal at ten meters long and five metric tons, but a 2011 measurement of a 1.4-meter tibia suggests a total body length of twelve to fourteen meters.
A Polish-Mongolian team found these remains in 1970 near the Nemegt locality, marking one of the first hadrosaurid specimens discovered in Asia.
As a hadrosaurid, this large herbivore walked on two or four legs and possessed hundreds of continually-replaced teeth adapted for a grinding motion.
If Barsboldia was a lambeosaurine, it would have possessed a hollow crest used for visual and auditory identification.
Maryańska and Osmólska originally classified it as a lambeosaurine, the first such dinosaur described from the Nemegt Formation, despite the absence of a skull.
However, a 2011 study suggests Barsboldia is a valid genus of saurolophine within the parent group Saurolophinae.
Due to the lack of a skull and only one partial skeleton, the validity and placement of Barsboldia have been debated, with some considering it a dubious genus.
